LESSON: READING 5.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we need to read keenly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaboratively rewrite the events and sections of a text in their own words. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing tools and materials, alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology to write,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship as the learner engage actively with others as they collaboratively rewrite the events and sections of a text in

their own words.

Values:
Patriotism is promoted as the learner respects peers when they jointly answer questions that activate previous knowledge

about the subject before reading a text.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Peaceful conflict management as learners exercise peaceful conflict management when they collaboratively rewrite the

events and sections of a text in their own words.

Suggested Learning Resources: Dictionaries, authentic materials such newspapers, recommended Text books, online

materials, adapted digital devices with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand.
